title.en: Databases with missing or old backups
title.pt-BR: Bancos com backup ausente ou antigo

impact.en: A failure or mistake on these databases may lose more data than you expect, or be unrecoverable.
impact.pt-BR: Uma falha ou erro nesses bancos pode perder mais dados do que você espera, ou não ter recuperação.

next_action.en: Check the backup jobs for these databases and run a manual backup now. In FULL recovery, schedule log backups too.
next_action.pt-BR: Verifique os jobs de backup desses bancos e faça um backup manual agora. Em recovery FULL, agende também backups de log.

verify.en: After the backup finishes, confirm it in msdb: `SELECT database_name, type, MAX(backup_finish_date) FROM msdb.dbo.backupset GROUP BY database_name, type`. Each database must show a recent D (full) and, in FULL recovery, an L (log) newer than 24 hours. Also run `RESTORE VERIFYONLY` on the file.
verify.pt-BR: Quando o backup terminar, confirme no msdb: `SELECT database_name, type, MAX(backup_finish_date) FROM msdb.dbo.backupset GROUP BY database_name, type`. Cada banco deve mostrar um D (full) recente e, em recovery FULL, um L (log) com menos de 24 horas. Rode também um `RESTORE VERIFYONLY` no arquivo.

caveat.en: Based on msdb history on this instance. Backups taken by external tools without msdb history are not visible.
caveat.pt-BR: Baseado no histórico do msdb desta instância. Backups de ferramentas externas sem histórico no msdb não aparecem.

saas_cta.en: codeDB checks backups continuously and alerts you the moment one is late.
saas_cta.pt-BR: O codeDB verifica os backups continuamente e alerta assim que um atrasa.

rule.query:
WITH b AS (
    SELECT database_name,
           MAX(CASE WHEN type = 'D' THEN backup_finish_date END) AS last_full,
           MAX(CASE WHEN type = 'I' THEN backup_finish_date END) AS last_diff,
           MAX(CASE WHEN type = 'L' THEN backup_finish_date END) AS last_log
    FROM msdb.dbo.backupset
    WHERE is_copy_only = 0
    GROUP BY database_name
)
SELECT d.name                AS [database],
       d.recovery_model_desc AS recovery_model,
       b.last_full,
       b.last_diff,
       b.last_log,
       CASE
           WHEN b.last_full IS NULL THEN 'no full backup'
           WHEN ISNULL(b.last_diff, b.last_full) < DATEADD(hour, -{{full_max_hours}}, GETDATE())
                AND b.last_full < DATEADD(hour, -{{full_max_hours}}, GETDATE()) THEN 'full/diff too old'
           ELSE 'log backup too old'
       END AS problem
FROM sys.databases d
LEFT JOIN b ON b.database_name = d.name
WHERE d.database_id <> 2               -- tempdb
  AND d.state_desc = 'ONLINE'
  AND d.source_database_id IS NULL     -- snapshots
  AND (
        b.last_full IS NULL
     OR (ISNULL(b.last_diff, b.last_full) < DATEADD(hour, -{{full_max_hours}}, GETDATE())
         AND b.last_full < DATEADD(hour, -{{full_max_hours}}, GETDATE()))
     OR (d.recovery_model_desc <> 'SIMPLE' AND d.name <> 'model'
         AND ISNULL(b.last_log, '19000101') < DATEADD(hour, -{{log_max_hours}}, GETDATE()))
  )
ORDER BY d.name;

title.en: Databases without a recent clean DBCC CHECKDB
title.pt-BR: Bancos sem DBCC CHECKDB recente e sem erros

impact.en: Corruption can sit unnoticed for weeks and end up in every backup, leaving nothing clean to restore.
impact.pt-BR: Uma corrupção pode passar semanas sem ser notada e entrar em todos os backups, sem deixar nada limpo para restaurar.

next_action.en: Schedule DBCC CHECKDB (WITH NO_INFOMSGS, ALL_ERRORMSGS) at least weekly, or on a restored copy if the window is short.
next_action.pt-BR: Agende DBCC CHECKDB (WITH NO_INFOMSGS, ALL_ERRORMSGS) pelo menos semanalmente, ou numa cópia restaurada se a janela for curta.

verify.en: After DBCC CHECKDB completes without errors, confirm the date: `SELECT DATABASEPROPERTYEX(N'db', 'LastGoodCheckDbTime')` must be today. Then check that the schedule really runs: the value should renew at least once a week.
verify.pt-BR: Depois que o DBCC CHECKDB terminar sem erros, confirme a data: `SELECT DATABASEPROPERTYEX(N'banco', 'LastGoodCheckDbTime')` deve ser hoje. Depois confira se o agendamento roda de fato: o valor deve se renovar pelo menos uma vez por semana.

caveat.en: Reads LastGoodCheckDbTime, which only records runs that finished without errors. Databases created in the last days are skipped.
caveat.pt-BR: Lê o LastGoodCheckDbTime, que só registra execuções concluídas sem erros. Bancos criados nos últimos dias são ignorados.

saas_cta.en: codeDB tracks integrity checks on every instance and warns when one is overdue.
saas_cta.pt-BR: O codeDB acompanha os checks de integridade de todas as instâncias e avisa quando um atrasa.

rule.query:
SELECT d.name AS [database],
       NULLIF(CAST(DATABASEPROPERTYEX(d.name, 'LastGoodCheckDbTime') AS datetime), '19000101') AS last_good_checkdb,
       DATEDIFF(day, NULLIF(CAST(DATABASEPROPERTYEX(d.name, 'LastGoodCheckDbTime') AS datetime), '19000101'), GETDATE()) AS days_ago,
       d.create_date
FROM sys.databases d
WHERE d.database_id <> 2                -- tempdb
  AND d.state_desc = 'ONLINE'
  AND d.source_database_id IS NULL      -- snapshots
  AND d.create_date < DATEADD(day, -{{max_days}}, GETDATE())
  AND ISNULL(CAST(DATABASEPROPERTYEX(d.name, 'LastGoodCheckDbTime') AS datetime), '19000101') < DATEADD(day, -{{max_days}}, GETDATE())
ORDER BY d.name;

rule.permission: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+ VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

title.en: The instance spends a lot of time waiting on one resource
title.pt-BR: A instância passa muito tempo esperando por um recurso

impact.en: Waits are where query time goes when it isn't running. A dominant wait points straight at the bottleneck (disk, locks, CPU, memory).
impact.pt-BR: As esperas mostram para onde vai o tempo das consultas quando elas não estão executando. Uma espera dominante aponta direto para o gargalo (disco, bloqueios, CPU, memória).

next_action.en: Start with the top row. The meaning column says which resource to look at; the rule's documentation page lists the usual causes for each wait.
next_action.pt-BR: Comece pela primeira linha. A coluna de significado diz qual recurso investigar; a página da regra na documentação lista as causas comuns de cada espera.

verify.en: Waits are cumulative since the last restart, so a fix only shows as a change over time. Sample twice, some hours apart, and compare: `SELECT wait_type, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type = N'the_wait'`. The growth per hour of that wait must be clearly lower than before the change. On a test instance you can zero the counters with `DBCC SQLPERF('sys.dm_os_wait_stats', CLEAR)`.
verify.pt-BR: As esperas acumulam desde o último restart, então a correção só aparece como mudança ao longo do tempo. Colete duas vezes, com algumas horas de intervalo, e compare: `SELECT wait_type, wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type = N'a_espera'`. O crescimento por hora dessa espera deve ficar claramente menor que antes da mudança. Em instância de teste dá para zerar os contadores com `DBCC SQLPERF('sys.dm_os_wait_stats', CLEAR)`.

caveat.en: Totals accumulate since the last restart, so they show the long-term profile, not what is happening right now. Only deltas over time show the present.
caveat.pt-BR: Os totais acumulam desde o último restart, então mostram o perfil de longo prazo, não o que acontece agora. Só diferenças ao longo do tempo mostram o presente.

saas_cta.en: codeDB samples waits every minute, so you can see what changed at 03:12, not just since the last restart.
saas_cta.pt-BR: O codeDB amostra as esperas a cada minuto, para você ver o que mudou às 03:12, e não só desde o último restart.

rule.query:
-- Only waits with a clear meaning are counted; idle and background waits never reach the report.
WITH meaning (pattern, cat_en, cat_pt) AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        ('PAGEIOLATCH[_]%',         'Disk: reading data pages',                     'Disco: leitura de páginas de dados'),
        ('WRITELOG',                'Disk: transaction log writes',                 'Disco: escrita no log de transações'),
        ('IO[_]COMPLETION',         'Disk: other I/O',                              'Disco: outros I/O'),
        ('LCK[_]M[_]%',             'Blocking: waiting for locks',                  'Bloqueio: esperando locks'),
        ('PAGELATCH[_]%',           'Page contention in memory (often TempDB)',     'Disputa de páginas em memória (geralmente TempDB)'),
        ('SOS[_]SCHEDULER[_]YIELD', 'CPU pressure',                                 'Pressão de CPU'),
        ('CXPACKET',                'Parallelism',                                  'Paralelismo'),
        ('CXCONSUMER',              'Parallelism',                                  'Paralelismo'),
        ('RESOURCE[_]SEMAPHORE',    'Queries waiting for memory grants',            'Consultas esperando memória'),
        ('THREADPOOL',              'Out of worker threads',                        'Falta de threads de trabalho'),
        ('ASYNC[_]NETWORK[_]IO',    'Application not reading results fast enough',  'Aplicação lendo resultados devagar'),
        ('HADR[_]SYNC[_]COMMIT',    'Synchronous Availability Group commit',        'Commit síncrono do Availability Group')
    ) v (pattern, cat_en, cat_pt)
),
c AS (
    SELECT m.cat_en, MAX(m.cat_pt) AS cat_pt, SUM(ws.wait_time_ms) AS ms, SUM(ws.waiting_tasks_count) AS tasks,
           MAX(ws.wait_type) AS example
    FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats ws
    JOIN meaning m ON ws.wait_type LIKE m.pattern
    WHERE ws.wait_time_ms > 0
    GROUP BY m.cat_en
),
t AS (SELECT SUM(ms) AS total FROM c),
up AS (SELECT DATEDIFF(second, sqlserver_start_time, SYSDATETIME()) / 3600.0 AS hours FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info)
SELECT c.cat_en AS [meaning@en],
       c.cat_pt AS [meaning@pt-BR],
       c.example AS wait_type,
       CAST(c.ms * 100.0 / t.total AS decimal(5, 1)) AS share_pct,
       CAST(c.ms / 1000.0 / NULLIF(up.hours, 0) AS decimal(14, 1)) AS wait_s_per_hour,
       CAST(c.ms * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.tasks, 0) AS decimal(14, 1)) AS avg_wait_ms,
       CASE WHEN c.cat_en IN ('Out of worker threads', 'Queries waiting for memory grants') THEN 'confirmed' ELSE 'hint' END AS _confidence
FROM c CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN up
WHERE c.ms * 100.0 / t.total >= {{min_share_pct}}
  AND c.ms / 1000.0 / NULLIF(up.hours, 0) >= {{min_wait_s_per_hour}}
ORDER BY c.ms DESC;

rows: Disk reads (data pages not in memory)
Leitura de disco (páginas fora da memória)

rule.permission: VIEW SERVER STATE (host CPU and RAM)

title.en: Instance settings left at defaults that hurt performance
title.pt-BR: Configurações da instância no padrão que prejudicam o desempenho

impact.en: Default memory can starve the OS; default parallelism settings make small queries go parallel and fight for CPU.
impact.pt-BR: A memória padrão pode sufocar o sistema operacional; o paralelismo padrão faz consultas pequenas rodarem em paralelo e disputarem CPU.

next_action.en: Review each setting with sp_configure, starting with max server memory. Change one at a time and observe.
next_action.pt-BR: Revise cada configuração com sp_configure, começando pelo max server memory. Mude uma por vez e observe.

verify.en: Check the value in use, not just the configured one: `SELECT name, value, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name IN ('max server memory (MB)', 'max degree of parallelism', 'cost threshold for parallelism', 'optimize for ad hoc workloads')`. `value_in_use` must show the new number (run `RECONFIGURE` if it does not). Then watch CPU and memory for a few days.
verify.pt-BR: Confira o valor em uso, não só o configurado: `SELECT name, value, value_in_use FROM sys.configurations WHERE name IN ('max server memory (MB)', 'max degree of parallelism', 'cost threshold for parallelism', 'optimize for ad hoc workloads')`. O `value_in_use` deve mostrar o número novo (rode `RECONFIGURE` se não mostrar). Depois acompanhe CPU e memória por alguns dias.

caveat.en: Recommendations are common starting points, not universal rules. Hosts running other services may need different values.
caveat.pt-BR: As recomendações são pontos de partida comuns, não regras universais. Hosts com outros serviços podem precisar de outros valores.

rule.query:
WITH c AS (SELECT name, CAST(value_in_use AS bigint) AS v FROM sys.configurations),
     s AS (SELECT cpu_count, physical_memory_kb / 1024 AS ram_mb FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info)
SELECT 'max server memory (MB)' AS setting, CAST(c.v AS varchar(20)) AS current_value,
       CAST(CAST(s.ram_mb * 0.8 AS bigint) AS varchar(20)) AS suggested, CAST(s.ram_mb AS varchar(20)) + ' MB RAM' AS host
FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE c.name = 'max server memory (MB)' AND c.v >= 2147483647
UNION ALL
SELECT 'max degree of parallelism', CAST(c.v AS varchar(20)), '8', CAST(s.cpu_count AS varchar(20)) + ' CPUs'
FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE c.name = 'max degree of parallelism' AND c.v = 0 AND s.cpu_count > {{maxdop_cpus}}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cost threshold for parallelism', CAST(c.v AS varchar(20)), '50', CAST(s.cpu_count AS varchar(20)) + ' CPUs'
FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE c.name = 'cost threshold for parallelism' AND c.v = 5
UNION ALL
SELECT 'optimize for ad hoc workloads', CAST(c.v AS varchar(20)), '1', NULL
FROM c WHERE c.name = 'optimize for ad hoc workloads' AND c.v = 0;

impact.en: The optimizer recorded queries that would run much cheaper with an index that doesn't exist. They read more pages and hold locks longer than needed.
impact.pt-BR: O otimizador registrou consultas que ficariam bem mais baratas com um índice que não existe. Elas leem mais páginas e seguram locks por mais tempo que o necessário.

next_action.en: Treat each row as a lead, not a command. Compare it with the existing indexes on the table, merge similar suggestions and test the index before creating it in production.
next_action.pt-BR: Trate cada linha como pista, não como ordem. Compare com os índices que já existem na tabela, junte sugestões parecidas e teste o índice antes de criar em produção.

verify.en: After creating the index, run the query that motivated it and compare logical reads and duration with `SET STATISTICS IO, TIME ON` (or the actual plan: a seek on the new index instead of a scan). Later, confirm it is used: `SELECT i.name, s.user_seeks, s.user_scans FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats s ON s.object_id = i.object_id AND s.index_id = i.index_id AND s.database_id = DB_ID() WHERE i.name = N'index_name'`. The suggestion leaves the DMV after the next restart or index change.
verify.pt-BR: Depois de criar o índice, rode a consulta que o motivou e compare leituras lógicas e duração com `SET STATISTICS IO, TIME ON` (ou o plano real: seek no índice novo em vez de scan). Mais tarde, confirme que ele é usado: `SELECT i.name, s.user_seeks, s.user_scans FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats s ON s.object_id = i.object_id AND s.index_id = i.index_id AND s.database_id = DB_ID() WHERE i.name = N'nome_do_indice'`. A sugestão sai da DMV depois do próximo restart ou de mudança no índice.

caveat.en: Always a hint. The DMV ignores existing similar indexes, suggests overlapping indexes, and is cleared on restart.
caveat.pt-BR: Sempre um indício. A DMV ignora índices parecidos que já existem, sugere índices sobrepostos e é zerada no restart.

rule.query:
SELECT TOP (20)
       DB_NAME(d.database_id) AS [database],
       d.statement AS [table],
       d.equality_columns,
       d.inequality_columns,
       d.included_columns,
       s.user_seeks + s.user_scans AS uses,
       CAST(s.avg_user_impact AS decimal(5, 1)) AS est_impact_pct,
       CAST(s.avg_total_user_cost * s.avg_user_impact * (s.user_seeks + s.user_scans) AS decimal(18, 0)) AS improvement,
       s.last_user_seek
FROM sys.dm_db_missing_index_details d
JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_groups g ON g.index_handle = d.index_handle
JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_group_stats s ON s.group_handle = g.index_group_handle
WHERE d.database_id > 4
  AND s.avg_user_impact >= {{min_impact_pct}}
  AND s.avg_total_user_cost * s.avg_user_impact * (s.user_seeks + s.user_scans) >= {{min_improvement}}
ORDER BY improvement DESC;

title.pt-BR: Jobs do SQL Agent com falha

impact.en: Failed jobs usually mean backups, maintenance or data loads that silently stopped happening.
impact.pt-BR: Jobs com falha geralmente significam backups, manutenção ou cargas de dados que pararam de acontecer sem ninguém perceber.

next_action.en: Open the job history for each job, fix the failing step and set up an operator to be notified on failure.
next_action.pt-BR: Abra o histórico de cada job, corrija o passo que falha e configure um operador para ser notificado em caso de falha.

verify.en: Run the failing job manually (`EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_start_job N'job name'`) and check that its last outcome in the job history is Succeeded. Then wait for the next scheduled run: the job stops appearing here once its latest outcome is a success.
verify.pt-BR: Execute o job manualmente (`EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_start_job N'nome do job'`) e confirme no histórico que o último resultado é Succeeded. Depois espere a próxima execução agendada: o job deixa de aparecer aqui quando o resultado mais recente é sucesso.

caveat.en: Shows enabled jobs whose last run failed within the window. Not available on Express or Azure SQL Database (no Agent).
caveat.pt-BR: Mostra jobs habilitados cuja última execução falhou dentro da janela. Não existe no Express nem no Azure SQL Database (sem Agent).

saas_cta.en: codeDB alerts on Teams, Slack or e-mail the moment a job fails.
saas_cta.pt-BR: O codeDB alerta no Teams, Slack ou e-mail assim que um job falha.

rule.query:
WITH h AS (
    SELECT jh.job_id, jh.run_status, jh.message,
           CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(char(8), jh.run_date))
             + CONVERT(datetime, STUFF(STUFF(RIGHT('000000' + CAST(jh.run_time AS varchar(6)), 6), 5, 0, ':'), 3, 0, ':')) AS run_at,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY jh.job_id ORDER BY jh.instance_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory jh
    WHERE jh.step_id = 0                -- job outcome
)
SELECT j.name AS job,
       h.run_at AS last_run,
       CASE h.run_status WHEN 0 THEN 'failed' WHEN 3 THEN 'canceled' END AS outcome,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h AS x WHERE x.job_id = j.job_id AND x.run_status = 0
          AND x.run_at >= DATEADD(day, -{{days}}, GETDATE())) AS failures_in_window,
       LEFT(h.message, 300) AS message
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j
JOIN h ON h.job_id = j.job_id AND h.rn = 1
WHERE j.enabled = 1
  AND h.run_status IN (0, 3)
  AND h.run_at >= DATEADD(day, -{{days}}, GETDATE())
ORDER BY h.run_at DESC;

results.reason: The SELECT permission was denied on the object 'sysjobhistory', database 'msdb'.

rule.permission: VIEW SERVER STATE + VIEW ANY DEFINITION + CONNECT ANY DATABASE

impact.en: Every index is updated on every insert, update and delete. Indexes nobody reads only slow writes down, take space and lengthen maintenance.
impact.pt-BR: Todo índice é atualizado em cada insert, update e delete. Índices que ninguém lê só deixam as escritas mais lentas, ocupam espaço e alongam a manutenção.

next_action.en: Confirm over a full business cycle (month-end, reports) before dropping. Script the index first so it can be recreated, or disable it instead of dropping.
next_action.pt-BR: Confirme durante um ciclo completo do negócio (fechamento de mês, relatórios) antes de remover. Gere o script do índice antes, para poder recriá-lo, ou desabilite em vez de remover.

verify.en: Before dropping, check the index in `sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats` (`user_seeks + user_scans + user_lookups` vs `user_updates`): zero reads over a full business cycle confirms it. After dropping or disabling, watch the application for a few days (slow queries, new missing index hints); if something regresses, recreate the index from the script you saved. Writes on the table should get cheaper.
verify.pt-BR: Antes de remover, veja o índice em `sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats` (`user_seeks + user_scans + user_lookups` contra `user_updates`): zero leituras em um ciclo completo de negócio confirma. Depois de remover ou desabilitar, acompanhe a aplicação por alguns dias (consultas lentas, novas sugestões de índice faltando); se algo piorar, recrie o índice pelo script que você guardou. As escritas na tabela devem ficar mais baratas.

caveat.en: Usage statistics reset on restart; the longer the instance has been up, the more reliable this is. Replicas and readable secondaries have their own usage.
caveat.pt-BR: As estatísticas de uso zeram no restart; quanto mais tempo a instância está no ar, mais confiável. Réplicas e secundárias legíveis têm uso próprio.

rule.query:
-- Runs in each database. Nonclustered, non-constraint indexes only.
WITH ix AS (
    SELECT i.object_id, i.index_id, i.name, i.filter_definition,
           OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(i.object_id) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS [table],
           (SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(c.name AS nvarchar(max)) + CASE WHEN ic.is_descending_key = 1 THEN ' DESC' ELSE '' END, ', ')
                   WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal)
            FROM sys.index_columns ic JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id
            WHERE ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id AND ic.key_ordinal > 0) AS keys
    FROM sys.indexes i
    WHERE i.type = 2 AND i.is_primary_key = 0 AND i.is_unique_constraint = 0 AND i.is_hypothetical = 0
      AND OBJECTPROPERTY(i.object_id, 'IsUserTable') = 1
),
u AS (
    SELECT ix.*,
           ISNULL(us.user_seeks + us.user_scans + us.user_lookups, 0) AS reads,
           ISNULL(us.user_updates, 0) AS writes,
           (SELECT SUM(ps.used_page_count) * 8 / 1024 FROM sys.dm_db_partition_stats ps
            WHERE ps.object_id = ix.object_id AND ps.index_id = ix.index_id) AS size_mb
    FROM ix
    LEFT JOIN sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats us
           ON us.database_id = DB_ID() AND us.object_id = ix.object_id AND us.index_id = ix.index_id
)
SELECT u.[table], u.name AS [index], 'unused' AS issue, u.keys, u.reads, u.writes, u.size_mb, CAST(NULL AS sysname) AS duplicate_of
FROM u
WHERE u.reads = 0 AND u.writes >= {{min_writes}}
UNION ALL
SELECT u.[table], u.name, 'duplicate', u.keys, u.reads, u.writes, u.size_mb, d.name
FROM u
JOIN u AS d ON d.object_id = u.object_id AND d.index_id < u.index_id
            AND d.keys = u.keys AND ISNULL(d.filter_definition, '') = ISNULL(u.filter_definition, '')
ORDER BY [table], [index];

impact.en: Blocked sessions wait for another session to release its locks. Users see timeouts and frozen screens.
impact.pt-BR: Sessões bloqueadas esperam outra sessão liberar seus locks. Os usuários veem timeouts e telas travadas.

next_action.en: Look at the blocker first. A blocker in "sleeping" status with an open transaction is usually an application that forgot to commit. Talk to its owner before considering KILL.
next_action.pt-BR: Olhe primeiro para quem bloqueia. Um bloqueador em status "sleeping" com transação aberta costuma ser uma aplicação que esqueceu o commit. Fale com o responsável antes de pensar em KILL.

verify.en: Re-check the blocking chain: `SELECT session_id, blocking_session_id, wait_time FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0`. It must come back empty, or with waits well below the threshold. One check is not enough: repeat it during the busy hours, since blocking comes and goes.
verify.pt-BR: Verifique a cadeia de bloqueio de novo: `SELECT session_id, blocking_session_id, wait_time FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0`. O resultado deve vir vazio, ou com esperas bem abaixo do limite. Uma checagem só não basta: repita nos horários de pico, porque o bloqueio vem e vai.

caveat.en: A snapshot only sees blocking happening at the moment of the check.
caveat.pt-BR: Um retrato só vê bloqueios que estão acontecendo no momento da verificação.

saas_cta.en: codeDB catches blocking chains as they happen, at any hour, and alerts you within minutes.
saas_cta.pt-BR: O codeDB pega cadeias de bloqueio na hora em que acontecem, a qualquer hora, e alerta em minutos.

rule.query:
SELECT r.session_id                    AS blocked_session,
       r.blocking_session_id           AS blocked_by,
       DB_NAME(r.database_id)          AS [database],
       CAST(r.wait_time / 1000.0 AS decimal(12, 1)) AS waiting_s,
       r.wait_type,
       bs.status                       AS blocker_status,
       bs.login_name                   AS blocker_login,
       bs.host_name                    AS blocker_host,
       bs.program_name                 AS blocker_program,
       bs.open_transaction_count       AS blocker_open_trans,
       LEFT(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.text, CHAR(13), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), 200) AS blocked_query
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions bs ON bs.session_id = r.blocking_session_id
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) t
WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0
  AND r.session_id <> @@SPID
  AND r.wait_time >= {{min_wait_ms}}
ORDER BY r.wait_time DESC;

rule.permission: VIEW SERVER STATE (2022+ VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE)

title.en: Disk or transaction log running out of space
title.pt-BR: Disco ou log de transações ficando sem espaço

impact.en: A full volume or log stops all writes in the affected databases. Usually it happens at the worst possible time.
impact.pt-BR: Um volume ou log cheio interrompe todas as escritas nos bancos afetados. Normalmente acontece na pior hora possível.

next_action.en: Volumes: free space or grow the disk. Azure SQL Database (kind database): raise the max size or the service tier, or free space. Logs: act on log_reuse_wait (LOG_BACKUP: take log backups; ACTIVE_TRANSACTION: find the open transaction; REPLICATION / AVAILABILITY_REPLICA: check the replica).
next_action.pt-BR: Volumes: libere espaço ou aumente o disco. Azure SQL Database (tipo database): aumente o tamanho máximo ou o nível de serviço, ou libere espaço. Logs: trate o log_reuse_wait (LOG_BACKUP: faça backup de log; ACTIVE_TRANSACTION: ache a transação aberta; REPLICATION / AVAILABILITY_REPLICA: verifique a réplica).

verify.en: For volumes, free space must rise above the thresholds: `SELECT DISTINCT s.volume_mount_point, s.available_bytes / 1048576 AS free_mb FROM sys.master_files f CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(f.database_id, f.file_id) s`. For logs, `SELECT name, log_reuse_wait_desc FROM sys.databases` must show NOTHING after the next log backup or checkpoint, and `DBCC SQLPERF(LOGSPACE)` must show a lower used percentage.
verify.pt-BR: Nos volumes, o espaço livre deve passar dos limites: `SELECT DISTINCT s.volume_mount_point, s.available_bytes / 1048576 AS free_mb FROM sys.master_files f CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(f.database_id, f.file_id) s`. Nos logs, `SELECT name, log_reuse_wait_desc FROM sys.databases` deve mostrar NOTHING depois do próximo backup de log ou checkpoint, e `DBCC SQLPERF(LOGSPACE)` deve mostrar percentual de uso menor.

caveat.en: A snapshot shows how full things are now, not how fast they grow. Only volumes that hold database files are checked.
caveat.pt-BR: Um retrato mostra o quanto está cheio agora, não a velocidade de crescimento. Só são verificados volumes com arquivos de banco.

saas_cta.en: codeDB projects when each volume and log will fill up and alerts you days before.
saas_cta.pt-BR: O codeDB projeta quando cada volume e log vai encher e alerta dias antes.

rule.query:
WITH vol AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.volume_mount_point, s.total_bytes, s.available_bytes
    FROM sys.master_files f
    CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(f.database_id, f.file_id) s
)
SELECT 'volume'                                                AS kind,
       v.volume_mount_point                                    AS name,
       CAST(v.available_bytes * 100.0 / v.total_bytes AS decimal(5, 1)) AS free_pct,
       CAST(v.available_bytes / 1048576 AS bigint)             AS free_mb,
       CAST(NULL AS decimal(5, 1))                             AS log_used_pct,
       CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(60))                              AS log_reuse_wait,
       CASE WHEN v.available_bytes * 100.0 / v.total_bytes < {{volume_confirmed_pct}} THEN 'confirmed' ELSE 'hint' END AS _confidence
FROM vol v
WHERE v.available_bytes * 100.0 / v.total_bytes < {{volume_hint_pct}}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'log', d.name, NULL, NULL,
       CAST(ls.active_log_size_mb * 100.0 / NULLIF(ls.total_log_size_mb, 0) AS decimal(5, 1)),
       d.log_reuse_wait_desc,
       CASE WHEN ls.active_log_size_mb * 100.0 / NULLIF(ls.total_log_size_mb, 0) >= {{log_confirmed_pct}} THEN 'confirmed' ELSE 'hint' END
FROM sys.databases d
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_db_log_stats(d.database_id) ls  -- per-database counters are unreliable on 2025
WHERE d.state_desc = 'ONLINE'
  AND d.log_reuse_wait_desc NOT IN ('NOTHING', 'CHECKPOINT')
  AND ls.active_log_size_mb * 100.0 / NULLIF(ls.total_log_size_mb, 0) >= {{log_hint_pct}};

title.en: SQL Server version out of support or close to it
title.pt-BR: Versão do SQL Server fora de suporte ou perto disso

impact.en: Out-of-support versions get no security fixes. Upgrades take months to plan, so the window matters.
impact.pt-BR: Versões fora de suporte não recebem correções de segurança. Upgrades levam meses para planejar, então o prazo importa.

next_action.en: Plan an upgrade to a supported version. Check application compatibility and the compatibility level of each database.
next_action.pt-BR: Planeje o upgrade para uma versão suportada. Verifique a compatibilidade das aplicações e o compatibility level de cada banco.

verify.en: After the upgrade, run `SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion'), SERVERPROPERTY('ProductLevel')` and confirm the major version is still inside support. Check each database with `SELECT name, compatibility_level FROM sys.databases` and let the application run a full cycle (including month-end jobs) before you decommission the old server.
verify.pt-BR: Depois do upgrade, rode `SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion'), SERVERPROPERTY('ProductLevel')` e confirme que a versão major ainda está dentro do suporte. Confira cada banco com `SELECT name, compatibility_level FROM sys.databases` e deixe a aplicação passar por um ciclo completo (incluindo rotinas de fechamento de mês) antes de desligar o servidor antigo.

caveat.en: Dates come from the Microsoft lifecycle table bundled in this Lens version. Update Lens to refresh them.
caveat.pt-BR: As datas vêm da tabela de ciclo de vida da Microsoft embutida nesta versão do Lens. Atualize o Lens para renová-las.

rule.query:
-- Microsoft lifecycle (extended support end). Source: learn.microsoft.com/lifecycle/products (SQL Server 2025: mainstream 2031-01-07, extended 2036-01-07)
WITH lifecycle (major, product, extended_end) AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (11, 'SQL Server 2012', CAST('2022-07-12' AS date)),
        (12, 'SQL Server 2014', CAST('2024-07-09' AS date)),
        (13, 'SQL Server 2016', CAST('2026-07-14' AS date)),
        (14, 'SQL Server 2017', CAST('2027-10-12' AS date)),
        (15, 'SQL Server 2019', CAST('2030-01-08' AS date)),
        (16, 'SQL Server 2022', CAST('2033-01-11' AS date)),
        (17, 'SQL Server 2025', CAST('2036-01-07' AS date))
    ) v (major, product, extended_end)
),
s AS (
    SELECT CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('ProductMajorVersion') AS int) AS major,
           CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion') AS nvarchar(32)) AS build,
           CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('ProductUpdateLevel') AS nvarchar(32)) AS update_level,
           CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('Edition') AS nvarchar(128)) AS edition
)
SELECT l.product,
       s.build,
       s.update_level,
       s.edition,
       l.extended_end AS extended_support_end,
       DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), l.extended_end) AS days_left,
       CASE WHEN l.extended_end < GETDATE() THEN 'confirmed' ELSE 'hint' END AS _confidence
FROM s
JOIN lifecycle l ON l.major = s.major
WHERE l.extended_end < DATEADD(day, {{warn_days}}, GETDATE());

rule.permission: VIEW ANY DEFINITION + VIEW SERVER STATE

title.en: TempDB files not laid out for concurrency
title.pt-BR: Arquivos do TempDB fora do padrão para concorrência

impact.en: Too few or uneven data files cause allocation contention (PAGELATCH waits); percent growth makes growth events slower and slower.
impact.pt-BR: Poucos arquivos de dados, ou de tamanhos diferentes, causam disputa de alocação (esperas PAGELATCH); crescimento em percentual deixa cada crescimento mais lento.

next_action.en: Use one data file per logical CPU up to 8, all with the same size and the same fixed growth in MB.
next_action.pt-BR: Use um arquivo de dados por CPU lógica, até 8, todos com o mesmo tamanho e o mesmo crescimento fixo em MB.

verify.en: List the files with `SELECT name, size * 8 / 1024 AS size_mb, growth, is_percent_growth FROM tempdb.sys.database_files`: data files must have the same size, fixed growth in MB (`is_percent_growth = 0`) and one file per logical CPU up to 8. New files and growth changes apply right away; shrinking or resizing existing files may need a restart. Then watch for PAGELATCH waits on tempdb.
verify.pt-BR: Liste os arquivos com `SELECT name, size * 8 / 1024 AS size_mb, growth, is_percent_growth FROM tempdb.sys.database_files`: os arquivos de dados devem ter o mesmo tamanho, crescimento fixo em MB (`is_percent_growth = 0`) e um arquivo por CPU lógica, até 8. Arquivos novos e mudanças de crescimento valem na hora; reduzir ou redimensionar arquivos existentes pode exigir restart. Depois acompanhe as esperas PAGELATCH no tempdb.

rule.query:
WITH f AS (SELECT name, type_desc, size, growth, is_percent_growth FROM sys.master_files WHERE database_id = 2),
     d AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(size) AS mn, MAX(size) AS mx FROM f WHERE type_desc = 'ROWS'),
     s AS (SELECT CASE WHEN cpu_count > 8 THEN 8 ELSE cpu_count END AS want FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info)
SELECT 'data file count' AS issue, CAST(NULL AS sysname) AS [file], CAST(d.n AS varchar(20)) AS current_value, CAST(s.want AS varchar(20)) AS suggested
FROM d CROSS JOIN s WHERE d.n < s.want
UNION ALL
SELECT 'data files with different sizes', NULL,
       CAST(d.mn * 8 / 1024 AS varchar(20)) + '-' + CAST(d.mx * 8 / 1024 AS varchar(20)) + ' MB', 'same size'
FROM d WHERE d.mn <> d.mx
UNION ALL
SELECT 'growth in percent', f.name, CAST(f.growth AS varchar(20)) + '%', 'fixed MB'
FROM f WHERE f.is_percent_growth = 1;

title.en: A single query dominates CPU usage
title.pt-BR: Uma única consulta domina o uso de CPU

impact.en: Tuning a database is rarely about tuning everything. When one query takes most of the CPU, fixing it pays more than anything else.
impact.pt-BR: Otimizar um banco quase nunca é otimizar tudo. Quando uma consulta leva a maior parte da CPU, corrigi-la rende mais que qualquer outra coisa.

next_action.en: Start from the first query in the evidence (the top 5 are listed). Look at its execution plan, missing indexes and whether it runs more often than it should.
next_action.pt-BR: Comece pela primeira consulta da evidência (as 5 maiores aparecem). Veja o plano de execução, os índices faltando e se ela roda mais vezes do que deveria.

verify.en: After the change (index, rewrite, plan fix), compare the query before and after in the plan cache: `SELECT total_worker_time / execution_count AS avg_cpu_us, total_logical_reads / execution_count AS avg_reads FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats WHERE query_hash = <hash>`. Average CPU and reads per execution should drop, and its share of the total CPU should fall below the threshold. Give it a few hours of normal load: a recompiled query starts its counters over.
verify.pt-BR: Depois da mudança (índice, reescrita, correção de plano), compare a consulta antes e depois no plan cache: `SELECT total_worker_time / execution_count AS avg_cpu_us, total_logical_reads / execution_count AS avg_reads FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats WHERE query_hash = <hash>`. O CPU médio e as leituras por execução devem cair, e a parcela dela no CPU total deve ficar abaixo do limite. Dê algumas horas de carga normal: uma consulta recompilada zera os contadores.

caveat.en: Based on the plan cache, which is cleared on restart and under memory pressure. Queries with OPTION (RECOMPILE) may not appear.
caveat.pt-BR: Baseado no plan cache, que é limpo no restart e sob pressão de memória. Consultas com OPTION (RECOMPILE) podem não aparecer.

saas_cta.en: codeDB keeps the query history, so you can see when a query started dominating and what changed.
saas_cta.pt-BR: O codeDB guarda o histórico das consultas, para você ver quando uma consulta passou a dominar e o que mudou.

rule.query:
WITH q AS (
    SELECT qs.query_hash,
           SUM(qs.total_worker_time)   AS cpu_us,
           SUM(qs.execution_count)     AS executions,
           SUM(qs.total_logical_reads) AS reads,
           SUM(qs.total_elapsed_time)  AS elapsed_us,
           MAX(qs.sql_handle)          AS sql_handle,
           MAX(qs.statement_start_offset) AS so,
           MAX(qs.statement_end_offset)   AS eo
    FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats qs
    GROUP BY qs.query_hash
),
t AS (SELECT SUM(cpu_us) AS total, MAX(cpu_us) AS top1 FROM q),
top5 AS (SELECT TOP (5) * FROM q ORDER BY cpu_us DESC)
SELECT CAST(top5.cpu_us * 100.0 / t.total AS decimal(5, 1)) AS cpu_pct,
       top5.executions,
       CAST(top5.cpu_us / 1000.0 / NULLIF(top5.executions, 0) AS decimal(14, 1))     AS avg_cpu_ms,
       CAST(top5.elapsed_us / 1000.0 / NULLIF(top5.executions, 0) AS decimal(14, 1)) AS avg_duration_ms,
       top5.reads / NULLIF(top5.executions, 0) AS avg_reads,
       DB_NAME(st.dbid) AS [database],
       LEFT(REPLACE(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(st.text, top5.so / 2 + 1,
            (CASE top5.eo WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text) ELSE top5.eo END - top5.so) / 2 + 1),
            CHAR(13), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), 300) AS query
FROM top5 CROSS JOIN t
OUTER APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(top5.sql_handle) st
WHERE t.total / 1000000.0 >= {{min_total_cpu_s}}
  AND t.top1 * 100.0 / t.total >= {{dominant_pct}}
ORDER BY top5.cpu_us DESC;

title.en: SQL Server build is behind the latest cumulative or security update
title.pt-BR: Build do SQL Server atrás da última atualização cumulativa ou de segurança

impact.en: Cumulative updates carry the bug and security fixes for your version. A build many months behind keeps known issues open and makes the next patch a bigger jump.
impact.pt-BR: As atualizações cumulativas trazem as correções de bugs e de segurança da sua versão. Um build muitos meses atrasado mantém problemas conhecidos em aberto e torna o próximo patch um salto maior.

next_action.en: Test the latest cumulative update, plus the security update (GDR) released on top of it if there is one, in a non-production copy and schedule it in a maintenance window.
next_action.pt-BR: Teste a última atualização cumulativa, mais a atualização de segurança (GDR) lançada sobre ela, se houver, numa cópia fora de produção e agende a aplicação numa janela de manutenção.

verify.en: After patching, run `SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion'), SERVERPROPERTY('ProductUpdateLevel')` and confirm the build matches the target CU or GDR. Check the SQL Server error log for startup errors and that jobs and replication or AG members came back healthy. Re-run codeDB Lens: the rule should be OK.
verify.pt-BR: Depois de aplicar o patch, rode `SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion'), SERVERPROPERTY('ProductUpdateLevel')` e confirme que o build bate com o CU ou GDR alvo. Confira no error log do SQL Server se não há erros na subida e se jobs e membros de replicação ou AG voltaram saudáveis. Rode o codeDB Lens de novo: a regra deve ficar OK.

caveat.en: Builds come from the Microsoft version history bundled in this Lens version. When the installed build is newer than the table, the result is only a hint; update Lens to refresh it. Security-only (GDR) builds are matched to the CU below them.
caveat.pt-BR: Os builds vêm do histórico de versões da Microsoft embutido nesta versão do Lens. Quando o build instalado é mais novo que a tabela, o resultado é só um indício; atualize o Lens para renová-la. Builds só de segurança (GDR) são associados à CU imediatamente anterior.
